# A fallen rival joins the victor. ROOT won, FROM lost.
country_event = {
	id = lr_world.90
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes

	immediate = {
		annex_country = {
			target = FROM
			transfer_troops = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = { tag = SPR tag = CRL tag = ESR }
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						SPR = {
							exists = yes
							NOT = { tag = ROOT }
							NOT = { tag = FROM }
						}
						CRL = {
							exists = yes
							NOT = { tag = ROOT }
							NOT = { tag = FROM }
						}
						ESR = {
							exists = yes
							NOT = { tag = ROOT }
							NOT = { tag = FROM }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			clr_global_flag = LR_spain_civil_war
			news_event = { id = lr_gnews.15 days = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { tag = CRL }
				set_cosmetic_tag = LR_CRL_spain
			}
			if = {
				limit = { tag = ESR }
				set_cosmetic_tag = LR_ESR_spain
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { FROM = { OR = { tag = JAP tag = JPE } } }
			news_event = { id = lr_gnews.16 days = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = { tag = ITA tag = PAP tag = TOS tag = TTS }
				NOT = {
					OR = {
				ITA = {
					exists = yes
					NOT = { tag = ROOT }
					NOT = { tag = FROM }
				}
				PAP = {
					exists = yes
					NOT = { tag = ROOT }
					NOT = { tag = FROM }
				}
				TOS = {
					exists = yes
					NOT = { tag = ROOT }
					NOT = { tag = FROM }
				}
				TTS = {
					exists = yes
					NOT = { tag = ROOT }
					NOT = { tag = FROM }
				}
					}
				}
			}
			set_global_flag = LR_italy_united
			clr_global_flag = LR_italian_war_on
			add_stability = 0.1
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { tag = TTS } }
				set_cosmetic_tag = LR_ITA_unified
			}
			if = {
				limit = { tag = TTS }
				set_cosmetic_tag = FRA_TTS_italy
			}
			news_event = { id = lr_world.110 }
		}
	}
}

# France's surrender terms. FROM has just given up.
country_event = {
	id = lr_world.92
	title = lr_world.92.t
	desc = lr_world.92.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_france_parade
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = lr_world.92.a
		FROM = { news_event = { id = lr_gnews.13 days = 1 } }
		annex_country = {
			target = FROM
			transfer_troops = yes
		}
		lr_fra_finish_war = yes
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = lr_world.93
	title = lr_world.93.t
	desc = lr_world.93.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_france_parade
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = lr_world.93.a
		FROM = { news_event = { id = lr_gnews.13 days = 1 } }
		FROM = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_in_faction = yes }
				leave_faction = yes
			}
		}
		# A country that lost all its land in the settlement is already gone.
		if = {
			limit = { FROM = { exists = yes } }
			white_peace = FROM
			set_autonomy = {
				target = FROM
				autonomous_state = autonomy_puppet
			}
			FROM = { lr_fra_name_puppet = yes }
		}
		lr_fra_finish_war = yes
	}
}
